Research notes (today is Monday, Oct 12, 2026):

**The TSX is closed today.** Monday, Oct 12 is Thanksgiving in Canada. An ad-hoc-news report says the TMX reopens Tuesday, October 13, at 9:30 a.m. ET after Thanksgiving. I found no trading data for Oct 12. That fits the holiday, but no result states the closure for today directly.

**Last close, Friday Oct 9, 2026 (TMX):**
- The S&P/TSX Composite closed at 35,664.62, up 519.24 points (1.477%). The day's range was 35,321.92 to 35,683.33.
- Month-to-date return was 1.217%, and year-to-date return was 12.461%.
- The 52-week high is 37,069.11 and the 52-week low is 29,530.92. A BBN Times article says the high was set in August 2026.
- Tradingeconomics says the rise came as weaker jobs data reinforced expectations that the Bank of Canada won't hike rates. Employment fell by 68,300, against an expected gain of 7,000.
- The unemployment rate edged up to 6.5%.
- Canadian yields fell, which supported credit-sensitive stocks.
